## maven-plugin-tools-3.11.0
[Release Notes - Maven Plugin Tools - Version 3.11.0](https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/ReleaseNote.jspa?projectId=12317820&version=12353824)
---

Bug
---

*   \[[MPLUGIN-496](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-496)\] - Translation for keys report.plugin.goal.yes,no are missing
*   \[[MPLUGIN-499](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-499)\] - Deprecate descriptions are missing in description table

Improvement
-----------

*   \[[MPLUGIN-450](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-450)\] - Make goal prefix mandatory by default
*   \[[MPLUGIN-474](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-474)\] - Improve descriptor docs for requiredJavaVersion
*   \[[MPLUGIN-492](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-492)\] - Documentation for plugins in general: Goals comprises more than that
*   \[[MPLUGIN-495](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-495)\] - WARNINGs based on usage of `@Component` for MavenSession/MavenProject instead of `@Parameter`

Task
----

*   \[[MPLUGIN-493](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-493)\] - Consistently evaluate skip parameter in MavenReport#canGenerateReport()
*   \[[MPLUGIN-498](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-498)\] - Move section rendering to separate methods

Dependency upgrade
------------------

*   \[[MPLUGIN-494](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-494)\] - Upgrade to Parent 41
*   \[[MPLUGIN-497](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MPLUGIN-497)\] - Upgrade components
